name: Alpbacher Seentour
kurzbeschreibung: The Alpbachtal Lakes Circuit through Kramsach connects Tirol's warmest swimming lakes—including Reintalersee and Krummsee—on a picturesque woodland valley hike.
preis: Walking trails freely accessible; lakeside lidos and parking lots apply fees
oeffnungszeiten: Trails open year-round; swimming beach amenities open May to September
beschreibung:
Überblick

The Alpbach Lake Tour (Alpbacher Seentour) looping through the Kramsach lake plateau in the Lower Inn Valley ranks among the most delightful recreational walking itineraries in Tirol. Sheltered within a sun-kissed basin between the limestone foothills of the Brandenberg Alps and the mouth of the Alpbach Valley, this route links a glittering chain of natural bathing waters. Due to its unique density of lakes, the area around Kramsach is affectionately dubbed 'Tirol's Little Scandinavia'. Most remarkably, because of their sunny, wind-protected hollows and shallow basins, Lake Reintalersee, Lake Krummsee, Lake Frauensee, and the secluded Lake Berglsteiner See represent the warmest natural swimming lakes in all of Tirol, with surface water temperatures climbing up to twenty-five degrees Celsius in midsummer. Crystalline emerald waters bordered by fragrant pine woods, reed beds, and manicured sunbathing lawns create an enchanting retreat for nature lovers.

Route & Anforderungen

The full classic circuit spans approximately ten kilometres with a gentle elevation gain of about 200 metres, requiring roughly three to three and a half hours of relaxed walking time. The route follows well-graded forest tracks, crushed-gravel pathways, and quiet rural lanes free from any mountainous hazards. Consequently, the excursion is exceptionally well-suited for families with children, senior walkers, and leisure hikers, with substantial sections also manageable with sturdy all-terrain strollers. Those seeking a shorter stroll can simply complete the idyllic loop around Lake Reintalersee alone (approx. 1 hour). Comfortable walking sneakers or light hiking shoes are ideal for the excursion, and packing swimwear in your daypack is highly recommended for refreshing spontaneous lake dips.

Besuch & Anreise

The principal gateway for the lake tour is the town of Kramsach. Motorists travel along the Inntal motorway A12 (exit Kramsach) and follow local directional signage to the designated municipal parking areas at Reintalersee (east and west shoreline car parks, pay-and-display). Rail travelers arrive via Austrian Federal Railways (ÖBB) at Brixlegg or Rattenberg-Kramsach train stations, where synchronized VVT regional buses provide frequent connections directly to the lakeshore trailheads.

Tipps

Plan a generous lunchtime rest stop at the tranquil Berglsteiner See hidden deeply in the mountain forest. The lakeside inn features a charming wooden dining deck perched right over the clear water serving classic Tyrolean specialties. At Lake Reintalersee, renting an electric or pedal boat offers a peaceful, scenic perspective across the pristine mountain basin.
